council: Bath and North East Somerset Council
sourceTitle: Payments, benefits and rewards (Fostering in Bath & North East Somerset)
feesNote: Carers receive the age-related payment plus a weekly tier payment; tiers reflect training and development and are agreed with the fostering team.
extras: Additional allowances for holidays, birthdays and festivals
Parent and child placements are paid at £964.08 a week
summary: Bath and North East Somerset pays an age-related weekly amount for each child plus a tier payment that rises as carers complete training. The council's page does not state which year the rates apply to, so we have listed them under the current financial year; check with the fostering team for the latest figures.
